cohort_accounting_note: Cohorts overlap: all-after-registration includes3 late first-pair segments. Only all_audited_training_segments is the unique union; never sum overlapping cohorts.
definition: 1000 arm updates =500 A updates+500 B updates in one complete registered segment. Slurm seconds x allocated1GPU is the bill; internal phases overlap and are not added.
limitations: No observed budget throughput contrast is a causal pruning-speed effect: workloads, cache state, node and concurrency differ.
First500 segments contain update0 and500 full validation, continuations one new full validation; all are itemized.
Success rates and full inference speed remain unmeasured by this artifact; no ranking or scientific claims.
Acceptance/engineering failures and other project stages are outside this training subtotal; retain them in root's complete formal bill.
No network/SSH/GPU/model/cache tensor/weight/sealed-state access, production orstate edit, Git action or experiment was performed.

long_cache_observed.black_preparation_cost_accounting: Already inaccepted job3005020 allocation; not free, not added again to training throughput.
notes: Publication/eviction byte sums are logged activity, not current resident bytes or disk highwater. Re-publications may repeat keys.
Only exact observed key sizes are reported. Unseen pool records are not filled using global mean; no full-pool resident-size claim.
cache_hit.seconds includes striped/transaction locks, integrity hashing and tensor load; it is not pure lock waiting. No tensor was opened by this audit.
cache_publish and feature/component generation times nest inside update/validation timing; do not add toSlurm cost.
A may trigger shared current+teacher+future generation although its loss has no future term. A/B elapsed differences are not causal method-speed differences.
Concurrent active/not-yet-pulled jobs can alter sharedLRU. Fullnamespace resident occupancy, cumulative contention and complete physical cache history are not identified here.
long_cache_observed.scope: Completed audited Long training logs only, including mixed firstpair and other parallel pairs; this is not the full concurrent namespace workload.

mutable_state_observation.state_current_round_cost_not_used: May include provisional running allocations; not substituted for the immutable unique terminal job bill.

observation_cutoff: Immutable root+independent receipts present when this audit began; ongoing/newly finished unreviewed work is excluded.

assumptions: Every not-yet-accepted1000 arm updates costs within the actual min/max observed22 completed parallel segments.
Remaining unmeasured suite/budget combinations and later cache-evicting/full5000 phases also fall within that envelope; this is unverified.
Eight slots remain continuously useful for training, with no scheduling, review, launch gaps, CPU requests or evaluation sharing.
No new failed/replayed allocations, repair runs, resource changes or hyperparameter changes.
Work already done in currently running jobs is uncredited. This is measured from accepted boundaries, not exact remaining compute at the clock time.
exclusions: All development/final closedloop and full/component profiling: unmeasured and unknown, not0.
Queue/wallclock calendar date and review downtime.
Future failure/repair costs and exact independent-run cache attribution.
remaining_training_condition.scenario_name: Conditional envelope from observed parallel complete-segment extrema; not a forecast or confidence interval.
